faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Please provide your order ID and I'll help you check the order status.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3–5 business days.

faqs.question: How can I get a refund?
faqs.answer: I can help with your refund. Please provide your order ID and the reason for the refund.

faqs.question: What should I do if my payment failed?
faqs.answer: If your payment failed, please check your payment details or try another payment method.

faqs.question: Money was deducted but order was not confirmed
faqs.answer: If money was deducted but your order was not confirmed, please contact support with your transaction details.

faqs.question: How can I reset my password?
faqs.answer: If you forgot your password, use the 'Forgot Password' option on the login page.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: Orders can usually be cancelled before they are shipped. Please provide your order ID.

faqs.question: How can I contact support?
faqs.answer: Please describe your issue and I'll try to help you. If the issue requires a human agent, please contact customer support.
